description: Coordinate the parity backlog design-and-implement loop.

input.description: Workflow arguments. `targetPhases` filters the canonical backlog, `maxItemsPerRun` bounds delegated iterations, `includePartialCapabilities` controls whether partial parity items stay eligible, and `referenceRepositoryRoot` may override the default local codex-agent reference repository.

output.description: Return initial routing state and preserve runtime inputs for backlog review and delegated handoff steps.
